choice_data_list: There were definitely some good points in today's race, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: Let's keep working on that until it becomes your strength!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—I see.
To polish—my weapon, is it?”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A weapon is... important.
—Let's go with that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Fill what is lacking.
No holding back—needed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Retrain.
That is what must be done now.
